parsed.notes:
Skills And Attributes For Success and To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have are required sections; Ideally, You'll Also Have is optional.
The inline 'plus experience' adds a mandatory experience ask; it does not mark that ask as optional.
Group 1 represents the 'one or more of these areas' alternatives after removing skills independently required elsewhere. The schema cannot fully express bundles of skills within an area or nested alternatives; AWS, Azure and GCP are flattened into that group and flagged for review.
Group 2 represents the optional alternatives of evaluation-dataset construction, fine-tuning and open-source contribution; only fine-tuning has a taxonomy entry. Unmapped entries cannot carry grouping in the requested schema.
CI/CD remains required because its required alternative-area mention overrides its optional evaluation-gates mention.
Cybersecurity is explicitly named in the taxonomy and is retained; security threat concepts such as prompt injection, data leakage and unsafe tool use are treated as domain knowledge rather than additional technical practices.
Secure AI operations is left unmapped rather than assuming the narrower taxonomy meaning of MLOps. AI red teaming is not equated with red-team tooling, and security architecture is not equated with software architecture.
Open-source project contribution is not interpreted as experience with open-source LLMs. Certification mentions are retained in unmapped rather than converted into additional technology requirements.
Technologies and practices appearing only in responsibilities, including structured outputs, are excluded.
